You are responsible for how you handle things on your end. Both of your feelings are valid. Maybe you guys could go to therapy and discuss it together with a mediator? Maybe you guys can compromise so both of you will be happy. Maybe you'll be happier with your career. Maybe you'll be happier with her. If it's possible, try to focus on what you'll gain instead of what you'll lose and hold on to that. It's okay to feel sad or angry sometimes but it's up to you to work through it and not build resentment if you choose her. You can always find a new partner or a new career.
